    `- How the score is built: ${read.formula}`,
    "",
    "## Case law analysis",
    "",
    ...caseLawSection(read),
    "",

    "",
    ...read.sentences.flatMap((s, i) => [
      `### ${i + 1}. Score ${s.truth}${s.clock ? ` · ${s.clock}` : ""}`,
      "",
      `> ${s.text}`,

      ...s.reasons.map((r) => `- ${r}`),
